timingRules.normalVersusDiagnostic: separate installed copies and observations; no subtraction to invent observer overhead
timingRules.normalCpu: process CPU user/system includes harness/promise activity, not isolated engine CPU
timingRules.watchdog: orchestrator budget exhaustion is Incomplete collection, never a fabricated native deadline result
timingRules.warmup: excluded from measured samples; retain outcome and numerical consistency checks
timingRules.environment: record actual Node/npm/browser/OS/hardware/executable and package/input/harness identities; no representative traffic or universal platform claim

decisionRule.correctnessGate: complete frozen coverage and independent results/arithmetic/state/input/artifact checks before latency interpretation
decisionRule.latency: report absolute/relative successful wall and CPU per workload/phase/host/configuration/deadline; keep outcome denominators and owner summaries
decisionRule.observedSeparation: For at least three fresh normal owners with comparable successful outcomes, strictly nonoverlapping owner-median ranges support observed faster/slower in these repeats only; overlapping ranges, zero timer floors or insufficient owners are Inconclusive/within observed variation. This is not a confidence interval or population claim.
decisionRule.p95: descriptive empirical nearest-rank same-cell quantiles only, not independent-device tails
decisionRule.capacity: refusal-to-success or reverse is capacity improved/regressed, never an equal-work speed ratio
decisionRule.sameRuntime: accepted/current equal runtime is a method/environment control; timing variation cannot be labeled another implementation gain
decisionRule.noOverallWinner: no weighted total without owner-selected workload distribution; retain every adverse and unavailable cell

semanticPilot.host: private controlled zero-clock host; explicit60000ms untimed verifier, not deadline/fairness evidence
checks: full eight-query public pagination and independent IDs/order
selected Inspector formula replay and literal facets/source
cross-role canonical core and complete public-result comparisons
timed top20 captures from both real-host deadline cohorts agree with corresponding full semantic prefix

environmentDriftRule: Use matched observed environment within every pair. If the frozen runtime/browser/hardware/toolchain cannot be retained, record a new method/environment revision before collection and keep its observations separate; never inherit or pool an old Pass.
